# moztopia/money

> Agent-first PHP SDK for exact monetary values and replaceable reference rates.
> Install verified numeric Git tags through the documented Composer VCS setup.

- [Integration instructions](docs/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md): start here when consuming
  the package; exact input, operation types, rounding, conversion and storage rules.
- [Installation](docs/INSTALLATION.md): actual availability and runtime requirements.
- [Quick start](docs/QUICKSTART.md): executable five-minute integration recipes.
- [Consuming AGENTS instructions](docs/CONSUMING_AGENTS.md): copyable application rules.
- [API reference](docs/API.md): generated exact public signatures, defaults and properties.
- [Failure handling](docs/ERRORS.md): owned exceptions and intentional recovery.
- [Dependencies](docs/DEPENDENCIES.md): implementation boundary and replacement risks.
- [Contracts](docs/CONTRACTS.md): mathematical semantics and canonical protocols.
- [Core recipes](docs/CORE.md): implemented exact values, calculations, allocation,
  custom currencies, formatting and serialization; execute examples/core.php.
- [Exchange recipes](docs/EXCHANGE_RATES.md): replaceable providers, strict dates,
  reproducible conversion, cache freshness and transport; execute examples/rates.php.
- [Laravel integration](docs/LARAVEL.md): explicit storage/currency declarations,
  native validation, discovery, injection and cache locking; executable probes linked.
- [Standard Money schema](resources/schema/money.schema.json): integer minor units
  as strings, never floating-point or major-unit JSON amounts.
- [Custom Money schema](resources/schema/custom-money.schema.json): registry identity,
  immutable definition version and precision must match the receiver's registry.
- [Reference vectors](tests/Fixtures/reference-vectors.json): fixed expected behavior.
- [Delivery evidence](docs/DELIVERY.md): stage status and verification limitations.
- [Acceptance evidence](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md): definition-of-done checks and open gates.
- [Maintenance instructions](AGENTS.md): only for modifying this repository.

Never invent an installation claim or API from the baseline alone. Follow the
installed version's package reference and executable examples.

by-dolly
